source: NASA/TP-2010-216115 Fig.22 (IST-1, level) and NASA/TP-2010-216125 Fig.36 (IST-2, grade), 0.12-0.32 g trend lines read from PDF vector paths (recalc/digitize_ist.py), each coefficient regressed linearly on total gravity-adjusted weight TGAW (N).
units: VO2 in mL/kg/min (per kg body mass); v in m/s; grade in %; TGAW in N
level_vo2: a*v^2 + b*v + c, where [a,b,c] = slope*TGAW + intercept (rows a,b,c; cols [slope, intercept])
grade_inc_vo2: A*G^2 + B*G at the IST-2 test speed v_ist2 (G>=0); rows A,B; cols [slope, intercept]
digitize_check: axis residual <= 0.017 mL/kg/min, quadratic fit RMS <= 0.10; visual overlay outputs_b/b_digitize_check_*.png
